title: Beyond CLIP: Calibrated (Few-Shot) Defect Detection With System One Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cameras and vision sensors are widely used for product and process inspection in manufacturing environments. Traditionally, this process required thousands of images of both nominal and defective products to train such models. Recent research shows that vision transformer (ViT) models, such as CLIP, can reduce this requirement to 50-100 images per nominal and defective class. However, collecting even 50 defective images can be difficult in high-yield or low-volume manufacturing processes. In this paper, we examine the utility of two recently proposed structured decision models (Jev and Clef-Flash) in applications using as few as k=2 reference images per class at inference. In the process, we provide three main contributions: (a) a framework for k-shot learning of these models for image classification/inspection applications; (b) an agentic approach for automatically refining the text descriptions that guide image classification in thes

translated_title: 超越CLIP：基于系统一决策模型的校准（少样本）缺陷检测
translated_abstract: 摄像头和视觉传感器在制造环境中被广泛用于产品和工艺检测。传统上，这一过程需要成千上万张正常产品和缺陷产品的图像来训练此类模型。最近的研究表明，诸如CLIP之类的视觉Transformer（ViT）模型可以将这一需求降低到每个正常类和缺陷类50-100张图像。然而，即使收集50张缺陷图像，在高良率或小批量制造工艺中也可能很困难。在本文中，我们研究了两种最近提出的结构化决策模型在推理时每类仅使用少至k=2张参考图像的应用中的实用性。在此过程中，我们提供了三个主要贡献：这些模型用于图像分类/检测应用的k样本学习框架；一种用于自动优化引导图像分类的文本描述的智能体方法……
tldr: 本文提出将结构化决策模型（Jev和Clef-Flash）应用于制造缺陷检测，实现了每类仅需2张参考图像的少样本学习，并提供了k样本学习框架与智能体自动优化文本描述的方法，超越了CLIP等现有模型。
en_tdlr: This paper applies structured decision models (Jev and Clef-Flash) to manufacturing defect detection, achieving calibrated few-shot learning with as few as k=2 reference images per class, and contributes a k-shot learning framework along with an agentic approach for automatically refining text descriptions guiding image classification, going beyond CLIP.
